name: Lulu Wilson
bio: Lulu Wilson (born October 7, 2005) is an American actress. She is known for her roles in the horror films Ouija: Origin of Evil (2016), Annabelle: Creation (2017), Becky (2020), and the 2018 adaptation of The Haunting of Hill House.
place: New York City, New York, USA
